mapper.sql: (select c.customer_name from crm_customer c where c.customer_id = (case i.biz_type when 'quote' then (select q.customer_id from biz_quote q where q.quote_id = i.biz_id) when 'contract' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = i.biz_id) when 'payment_reduce' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = (select p.contract_id from biz_payment_plan p where p.plan_id = i.biz_id)) when 'disclosure' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = (select d.contract_id from biz_disclosure d where d.disclosure_id = i.biz_id)) when 'stock_out' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = (select o.contract_id from biz_stock_order o where o.order_id = i.biz_id)) end)) as customer_name

select t.task_id, t.instance_id, t.node_id, t.node_name, t.approver_id, t.status, t.opinion, t.handle_time, t.create_time, i.biz_type, i.biz_id, i.biz_title, i.biz_amount, i.start_user_id, i.start_time, su.nick_name as start_user_name, au.nick_name as approver_name,
from flow_task t left join flow_instance i on t.instance_id = i.instance_id left join sys_user su on i.start_user_id = su.user_id left join sys_user au on t.approver_id = au.user_id
mapper.select:
AND t.approver_id = #{approverId} AND t.status = '0' AND i.status = '1' AND i.biz_type = #{bizType} AND i.biz_title like concat('%', #{bizTitle}, '%')
order by t.task_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into flow_task (instance_id, node_id, node_name, approver_id, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{instanceId}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeName}, #{approverId}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(1) from flow_task where instance_id = #{instanceId} and node_id = #{nodeId} and status = '0'

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where r.role_id = #{roleId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and u.user_id != 1 and u.dept_id = #{deptId}
